info.brief: Guest device credentials: a stable device id and secret that a game generates once, saves,
info.description:
Guest device credentials: a stable device id and secret that a game generates once, saves,
and presents to guest sign-in on every launch, so the same pair resumes the same player.

elements.name: generate
elements.brief: Generates a new device id and secret without saving them. The secret is standard base64
elements.description:
Generates a new device id and secret without saving them. The secret is standard base64
of 32 random bytes, the shape the server requires.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.doc: The random byte source and a fixed device id.

returnvalues.doc: The device id and the device secret.

elements.name: load_or_create
elements.brief: Loads the saved device id and secret, or generates a pair and saves it on first run. Outside
elements.description:
Loads the saved device id and secret, or generates a pair and saves it on first run. Outside
the engine it generates a pair without saving. On HTML5 a pair saved in the older save
format is replaced, since web builds writing it all minted the same id.

parameters.name: opts
parameters.doc: The save file, the random byte source and a fixed device id.

returnvalues.doc: The device id and the device secret.

elements.name: clear
elements.brief: Erases the saved pair, so the next `load_or_create` mints a new guest. The server account
elements.description:
Erases the saved pair, so the next `load_or_create` mints a new guest. The server account
is not deleted. Pass the same save file used to sign in.

elements.name: _base64
elements.brief: Internal. The standard base64 encoder `generate` uses, exposed for upstream's encoder
elements.description:
Internal. The standard base64 encoder `generate` uses, exposed for upstream's encoder
test.

properties.name: app
properties.brief: The save file's application name, passed to `sys.get_save_file`. Defaults to `"asobi"`.
properties.description: The save file's application name, passed to `sys.get_save_file`. Defaults to `"asobi"`.

properties.name: file
properties.brief: The save file's name, passed to `sys.get_save_file`. Defaults to `"guest_device"`.
properties.description: The save file's name, passed to `sys.get_save_file`. Defaults to `"guest_device"`.

properties.name: random_bytes
properties.brief: Returns `n` random bytes from a stronger source than the default, which uses the
properties.description:
Returns `n` random bytes from a stronger source than the default, which uses the
browser's crypto on HTML5 and a seeded `math.random` elsewhere. It must return at least
32 bytes when asked for 32.

properties.name: device_id
properties.brief: A fixed device id, used in place of a random one.
properties.description: A fixed device id, used in place of a random one.
